note: Mississippi River floodplain access on Fabius Chute below the levee north of Hannibal, with a concrete boat ramp. MDC lists designated camping but maps no camping spot; the only place a vehicle can stop is the gravel boat-ramp lot (this pin). The area floods when the Mississippi nears flood stage; do not drive onto flooded roads. --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE (ramp-lot camping): area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' but says 'The only facilities on the area are a concrete boat ramp which offers access to the Mississippi River and gravel parking lot'; the 01/13 map has no camping symbol and GIS no camping point, so camping can only be in the boat-ramp lot. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin = the ramp lot. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: CRITERIA / DROP CANDIDATE (ramp-lot camping): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; 'The only facilities on the area are a concrete boat ramp which offers access to the Mississippi River and gravel parking lot.' The map (© 01/13) legend is Boundary, Gravel Road, Railroad, Levee, Parking Lot, Boat Ramp, Forest - no camping symbol. MDC's GIS camping layer has no point; the parking layer has one lot (2354). Vehicles are restricted to 'graveled and paved roads and established parking areas' (page regulations), so a vehicle camper can only be in the ramp lot: a sandy gravel lot ~50 x 40 m on the chute bank inside the levee, the ramp off its east corner. That is the ramp-lot pattern the brief drops (Cross Timbers, Dodd Access, Bird's Blue Hole).

FLOODING: area page 'Notice: This area is subject to flooding. Check local conditions, and do not drive onto flooded roadways... The area is prone to flooding when the Mississippi River approaches flood stage.' Put in the note.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the lot's NE edge is ~10-20 m from Fabius Chute (~60 m wide) through a strip of trees; the only opening is the ramp lane. No camping spot to measure from; the ramp lot fails the open-apron rule.
PIN: stored 39.86031,-91.45359 = GIS lot 2354, the ramp lot. Fine for what is there.
